title: ThrillSeeker’s Guide to The Galaxy
description:
Welcome, seeker of thrills!This is a simple session: I fractionate your mind and take you into the deepest of depths, where I rearrange the atoms of your brain and introduce you to the idea that our own limits can be broken and reforged.The focus of the file is to push you over the edge and well into a particular sort of mindset where your conditioning perpetually encourages you to deeply explore everything within reach. Every kink, every desire, every drop, every session, every hobby, every interest… any and all become concepts that your mind must explore to the fullest. That your mind must reach out to and map completely.Just listen! Allow yourself to be drawn in by the void. By the call of the void. Throw yourself in. Stop resisting.
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
Click on the three “dots” to the right of the player and choosedownloadfrom the menu.If there is no “download” option, try a different browser, like Chrome or Firefox.
